themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, framing border crises as existential threats to national security and cultural identity. This theme is particularly strong in countries like Italy, Spain, Germany, and the U.S., where leaders are advocating for stricter border controls, deportations, and opposition to asylum policies.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders seek re-election amid economic controversies
themes.blurb: Leaders from right-wing and far-right parties are positioning themselves for re-election despite facing significant economic backlash. This includes Javier Milei in Argentina, who is pushing controversial reforms, and figures in Poland and Hungary navigating internal party divisions and economic challenges. The theme highlights how economic policies are central to their re-election strategies.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant gains in polls across Europe, particularly in Germany, Sweden, and France. This trend reflects growing public dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a shift toward nationalist and anti-establishment platforms. The theme highlights how far-right parties are capitalizing on economic and social anxieties to expand their influence.
